title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente.
In a pan, cook the pancetta until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
In a bowl, beat the eggs and mix in the Pecorino and Parmesan cheese.
Drain the spaghetti and return it to the pot. Quickly add the egg and cheese mixture, stirring vigorously to create a creamy sauce.
Add the cooked pancetta and season with black pepper. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Grilled chicken cooked in a smooth, creamy tomato-based gravy.
instructions: Cut chicken breast into cubes and marinate in yogurt and garam masala for 30 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a pan until golden brown.
In the same pan, sauté onions, garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and cook for another 5 minutes.
Combine the cooked chicken with the sauce and serve hot.
